title: GTA 6 Has More Than One Ending (and You Can Go Back) 🎬 #Shorts
description:
Reviews are out: Kotaku's reviewer reached GTA 6's finale after about 90 hours and has seen two different endings. After the credits, the game sends you back to the final choice so you can keep playing or try another ending. GFinity's review says each ending depends on choices you make in the story. Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told The New York Times his own playthrough took about 80 hours.

Sources: Kotaku (Nov 18, 2026), GFinity review (Nov 18, 2026), The New York Times interview with Rob Nelson. Images: official Rockstar Games trailers.

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
